title: EU coordination meeting
description: The EU are seeking a common position on the Minister's visit. The biscuits are divided according to a methodology nobody will explain.

attend.label: Attend and argue Bellaluxe's case
attend.text: You secure a speaking slot and an unusually generous biscuit allocation.

delegate.label: Send a colleague with a brief
delegate.text: Your colleague represents the mission. The joint position is less alarming than expected.

decline.label: Decline with apologies
decline.text: The EU proceed without you. Someone reallocates the biscuits.

onMiss.text: Nobody from Bellaluxe attends the EU meeting. The delegation notices.

title: Valdorian national-day reception
description: Valdoria invites the diplomatic corps to a reception at the golf club. The invitation says 'brief remarks'; staff are arranging extra seating.

attend.label: Attend the reception
attend.text: You congratulate Valdoria and meet half the diplomatic corps before the anthem reaches its third verse.

delegate.label: Send a colleague
delegate.text: Your colleague conveys Bellaluxe's congratulations and returns with three invitations and a tiny flag.

decline.label: Send diplomatic regrets
decline.text: Valdoria accepts your regrets and sends the programme anyway.

onMiss.text: Valdoria notices the empty Bellaluxe place card at its national-day reception.

title: UN development roundtable
description: UN partners are discussing a project the Minister may visit. All participating organisations request their logos above the title.

attend.label: Attend the roundtable
attend.text: You keep the project discussion on the agenda and the logos on a second page.

delegate.label: Send a colleague
delegate.text: Your representative brings the project partners' priorities back to the mission.

decline.label: Decline the meeting
decline.text: The roundtable continues without Bellaluxe; the project partners take note.

onMiss.text: The UN roundtable goes ahead without a Bellaluxe representative or reply.

title: Danish coordination coffee
description: Niko invites EU colleagues to compare notes before the next coordination meeting. The invitation promises coffee and a single agenda item.

attend.label: Attend the coffee
attend.text: Niko shares a useful draft and a surprisingly large pot of coffee.

delegate.label: Send a colleague
delegate.text: Your colleague exchanges notes with Niko and returns with the draft.

decline.label: Send regrets
decline.text: Niko accepts your regrets and circulates the draft without your comments.

onMiss.text: Niko notices that Bellaluxe neither attends nor replies to the Danish coffee invitation.

title: Valdorian colleagues' lunch
description: Mara invites a few diplomats to lunch to exchange views on the approaching ministerial visits. 'A few courses,' the invitation says.

attend.label: Attend the lunch
attend.text: Mara shares an unusually candid protocol tip between the fifth and sixth courses.

delegate.label: Send a colleague
delegate.text: Mara welcomes your colleague, who returns with a protocol tip and a menu the length of a cable.

decline.label: Decline politely
decline.text: Mara accepts your regrets and promises a shorter invitation next time.

onMiss.text: Mara finds an empty Bellaluxe place at the lunch and receives no reply to the invitation.

title: Danish national-day reception
description: Niko welcomes the diplomatic corps for Denmark's national day. The reception is being held at the EU Delegation while the Danish residence is repainted.

attend.label: Attend and congratulate Denmark
attend.text: You congratulate Niko, who insists the paint samples are not part of the national colours.

delegate.label: Send a colleague with congratulations
delegate.text: Your colleague delivers Bellaluxe's congratulations and returns with an invitation to inspect the new paint.

decline.label: Send diplomatic regrets
decline.text: Niko accepts your regrets and sends the speech in writing, including the footnotes.

onMiss.text: Niko receives neither a Bellaluxe representative nor a reply to the national-day invitation.

title: UN partners' final coordination
description: Amara convenes partners for a final exchange ahead of the Minister's arrival. The meeting is intended to last one hour; the agenda has seven annexes.

attend.label: Attend the coordination meeting
attend.text: You agree the remaining practical points with Amara and prevent a discussion about logo sizes from becoming an agenda item.

delegate.label: Send a colleague
delegate.text: Your representative checks the remaining arrangements and brings back an annotated programme.

decline.label: Decline with thanks
decline.text: Amara circulates the final notes to Bellaluxe, with a reminder that the meeting was meant to be collaborative.

onMiss.text: The final UN coordination meeting goes ahead without a Bellaluxe representative or reply.
